title: Hearing Lab Technology/Lucid Audio Recalls Children's HearMuffs Due to Burn and Injury Hazards from Rupturing Alkaline Batteries
summary: The AAA alkaline batteries included in the recalled HearMuffs can rupture, posing hearing, projectile and/or burn injury. Units: About 31,150.

title: Murphy Beds Recalled Due to Serious Impact and Crush Hazards; Manufactured by Cyme Tech (Recall Alert)
summary: The wall beds can break or detach from the wall and fall onto those nearby, posing serious impact and crush hazards. Units: About 8,200.

title: Roots & Harvest Wide Mouth Pint Canning Jars Recalled by LEM Products Distribution Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Pieces of glass can be found in some of the recalled jars, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 15,900.

title: Tethrd Recalls One Stick GEN 2 Climbing Sticks Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Under pressure, one or more of the climbing stick's steps can crack causing them to break, posing fall and injury hazards to users. Units: About 7,700.

title: Kolan Recalls Children's Sandals Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The inner layer of the recalled sandals contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 100.

title: Snow Joe Recalls Sun Joe® Cordless Lawn Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The mower blade can detach unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 26,300 (In addition, about 350 were sold in Canada).

title: TJX Recalls Outdoor Metal Hanging Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hanging chair can tip or fall over or the metal hook or chain suspending the chair can break when a consumer is seated in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 5,000 (In addition, about 194 were sold in Canada).

title: UPPAbaby Recalls RIDGE Jogging Strollers Due to Fingertip Amputation Hazard; One Injury to Child Reported
summary: The stroller's rear disc brakes have openings that can cause amputation or laceration if a non-occupant child's fingertip gets caught in the openings while the stroller is in use. Units: About 14,400.

title: Yuboloo Recalls Infant Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath seats fail to meet the federal safety standard for infant bath seats, including requirements for stability and leg openings, and can tip over while in use, posing a drowning hazard to babies. Units: About 1,050.

title: Accompany USA Recalls Ceramic Mugs with Cork Bottoms Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The coffee cup can crack or break when hot liquid is poured into it, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: Canyon Furniture Company Recalls Ladders Sold With Bunk Bed and Hutch Sets Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Rooms To Go (Recall Alert)
summary: The space between the fourth ladder step and the cross-member of the hutch of the bunk bed is wider than 3.5 inches, posing entrapment and strangulation hazards. Units: About 2,100.

title: Mr Maria Recalls Miffy First Lights Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled lights can overheat during use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 1,400.

title: Pool and Spa Drain Covers Recalled Due to Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Imported by Angzhili; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection standards of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Pool and Spa Drain Covers Recalled Due to Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Imported by Chyir Myd; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection standards of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 300.

title: Pool and Spa Drain Covers Recalled Due to Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Imported by Goetas; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection standards of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 300.

title: Spalding® Momentous EZ Portable Basketball Goals Recalled by Russell Brands Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: Welds in the arm attaching the backboard to the pole can fail and cause the backboard to fall, posing an impact injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,400 (In addition, about 62 were sold in Canada).

title: Wadoy Pool and Spa Drain Covers Recalled Due to Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Imported by Find4Fix; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection standards of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 5,500.

title: Baby Trend Recalls Cityscape Travel Jogger Strollers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The parking brake on the strollers can fail, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 310.

title: Cervélo USA Recalls R5 and Caledonia-5 Bicycles and Cervélo Replacement Stems Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The handlebars on the bicycles can slip in the stem and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,800 bicycles and 182 stems (In addition, about 243 bicycles were sold in Canada).

title: CPSC, thyssenkrupp Access Corp. Settle Lawsuit: Firm to Conduct Recall to Inspect Home Elevators Due to Entrapment Hazard Posing Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Children; One Child Death Reported
summary: Children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior hoistway door and the elevator car door or gate and suffer serious injury or death if the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 16,800 residential elevators, sold for between $15,000 and $25,000 for a two-landing installatio

title: BE Jewel Accessories Recalls Children's Hairclips Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The crystals on the hairclip contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 1,200.

title: Cambridge Elevating Residential Elevators Recalled Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate if there is a hazardous gap and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 1,700.

title: Custom Elevator Recalls Residential Elevators Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children; One Death Reported
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate if there is a hazardous gap between the doors and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: .

title: Hillsdale Furniture Recalls Flynn Twin Full Bunk Beds With Ladder Due to Entrapment Hazard; Sold Only at Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores (Recall Alert)
summary: The space between the second rung of the bed's ladder and the lower bunk frame is wider than 3.5 inches, posing an entrapment hazard to children, when the mattress is removed. Units: About 821.

title: Hyper Products Recalls HyperJuice Stackable GaN USB-C Chargers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The chargers can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,200 (In addition, about 54 were sold in Canada and about 4 were sold in Mexico).

title: Hyper Products Recalls HyperJuice USB-C Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery pack can overheat while charging, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,700 (In addition, about 151 were sold in Canada and about 7 were sold in Mexico).

title: North States Industries Recalls Toddleroo Rotating Cabinet Latches Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The latching button can dislodge and detach from the cabinet latches, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 103,000.

title: Rockgeist Recalls BarJam Brackets Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled bracket arms, attached to bicycle handlebars, can crack or break during use, causing the harness and gear to fall while the bicycle is in motion, posing a crash and injury hazards. Units: About 420.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Personal Transportation Vehicles (PTV) Due to Injury and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The PTV's steering knuckles and A-arms can break during or after an impact and cause loss of steering control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 34,000.

title: Yamaha Recalls Viking Off-Road Side-by-Side Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Improperly installed rear brake lines can cause brake fluid to leak and reduce vehicle control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 330.
